title: When notification's main body text is scrollable, scrollview is inset which looks weird
line: The scrollbar of a long notification popup now sits at the popup's edge instead of floating inside its margin.
explanation: The popup's body ScrollView sits inside the popup's padding like the rest of the content, so its scrollbar (with its own theme insets and separator) ended up a few pixels away from the popup border, looking inset and detached. The header and timeout bar already extend into that padding with negative layout margins. The body now does the same on the scrollbar's side while the scrollbar is shown and no icon sits next to it, so the scrollbar is flush with the popup edge like other Plasma scroll views.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: let the body scrollbar touch the popup edge

When the body text of a notification popup was long enough to scroll, its
scrollbar sat inside the popup padding, leaving an odd gap to the edge. The
body now extends into that padding while the scrollbar is shown.

BUG: 450699

patches.diff:
From b722196dec4408c2e86c6b659d356ed63e953ce2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:40:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: let the body scrollbar touch the popup
 edge

When the body text of a notification popup was long enough to scroll, its
scrollbar sat inside the popup padding, leaving an odd gap to the edge. The
body now extends into that padding while the scrollbar is shown.

BUG: 450699
---
 applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml
index bc2f8700de..ad9a418f81 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml
@@ -133,6 +133,8 @@ BaseDelegate {
         Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn
         Layout.columnSpan: icon.visible ? 1 : 2
         Layout.maximumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * delegateRoot.modelInterface.maximumLineCount
+        Layout.leftMargin: Layout.mirrored && scroll.PlasmaComponents3.ScrollBar.vertical.visible && !icon.visible ? -delegateRoot.modelInterface.popupLeftPadding : 0
+        Layout.rightMargin: !Layout.mirrored && scroll.PlasmaComponents3.ScrollBar.vertical.visible && !icon.visible ? -delegateRoot.modelInterface.popupRightPadding : 0
         // The body doesn't need to influence the implicit width in any way, this avoids a binding loop
         implicitWidth: -1
         implicitHeight: scroll.implicitHeight
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Long notify-send body: the scrollbar sits inside the popup margin, with a gap to the right edge.
Same notification: the scrollbar now reaches the popup edge.

review.text: Extending the body ScrollView into the popup padding when no icon is present is reasonable, but making Layout.leftMargin/Layout.rightMargin depend on scroll.PlasmaComponents3.ScrollBar.vertical.visible introduces a QML binding loop: changing the margin widens scroll and bodyLabel, which reduces bodyLabel.implicitHeight and can flip ScrollBar.vertical.visible back to false for text near maximumLineCount lines. Additionally, RTL mirroring was not tested on the rig and should be verified alongside boundary-length body text.
changes: Break the QML binding loop in applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml so Layout.leftMargin/Layout.rightMargin does not feed back into scroll.width -> bodyLabel.width -> bodyLabel.implicitHeight -> ScrollBar.vertical.visible (for example, apply the negative margin whenever !icon.visible unconditionally—since bodyLabel.width already reserves ScrollBar.vertical.width—or otherwise keep bodyLabel.width invariant to scrollbar visibility).
Verify both boundary-length notification bodies (right around maximumLineCount lines, confirming zero QML binding loop warnings) and RTL layout on the test rig.

Additionally, RTL mirroring was not tested on the rig and should be verified alongside boundary-length body text.
changes: Break the QML binding loop in applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml so Layout.leftMargin/Layout.rightMargin does not feed back into scroll.width -> bodyLabel.width -> bodyLabel.implicitHeight -> ScrollBar.vertical.visible (for example, apply the negative margin whenever !icon.visible unconditionally—since bodyLabel.width already reserves ScrollBar.vertical.width—or otherwise keep bodyLabel.width invariant to scrollbar visibility).
Verify both boundary-length notification bodies (right around maximumLineCount lines, confirming zero QML binding loop warnings) and RTL layout on the test rig.

reviews.text: Right file and a reasonable idea (header and timeout bar already bleed into the popup padding), but the after shot shows the scrollbar only moved ~13 px and still sits clearly inside the popup edge (mediacheck agrees), so the commit subject 'touch the popup edge' and the line 'sits at the popup's edge' overclaim and the reported inset is only reduced. The margin is conditional on ScrollBar.vertical.visible, while that visibility depends on bodyLabel.implicitHeight, and bodyLabel.width follows scroll.width, which the margin widens; for a body whose height is near maximumHeight, showing the scrollbar widens the text, reduces its height, hides the scrollbar, narrows the text again, and the layout can oscillate or warn about a binding loop.
changes: Keep the text column width unchanged when the scrollbar is shown (e.g. subtract the negative margin back from bodyLabel.width) so scrollbar visibility can't feed back into the margin, and only the scrollbar moves into the padding.
Make the scrollbar actually reach the popup edge (account for the remaining inset beyond popupRightPadding), or reword the commit subject/line to match what the screenshot shows.
Re-verify with a body whose height is right at the maximumLineCount threshold, and in RTL.
